shared_or_similar_visual_information: A shaded region with a plotted boundary. On the left, use the gray half-plane to the right of the descending dashed line through the origin. On the right, use the gray patch enclosed by the blue cubic and orange cube-root curves between x = 0 and x = 1.
mathematical_meanings: Left image: It marks the open solution half-plane of a strict linear inequality. Right image: It selects the bounded area between the two function graphs.
Rationales: The left selection describes an allowable side or range relative to a plotted comparison. The right fill selects a gap between curves whose height is found by subtraction for an area calculation.
